name: Alistair Humphrey
bio:
Alistair Humphrey's motorsport journey began in the late 90s, fueled by a childhood passion for Formula One. He started as a junior mechanic, working his way up through the ranks with relentless dedication. His sharp eye for detail and unwavering commitment to performance soon caught the attention of senior engineers, leading to opportunities in team management.

After a decade honing his skills across various motorsport disciplines, Alistair found his niche in Formula racing. He is known for his data-driven decision-making and fostering a culture of accountability within his teams. Alistair believes in empowering his staff while maintaining a high standard of excellence, a trait that has earned him both respect and the reputation for being demanding.

Now at Trident, Alistair brings a wealth of experience to the table. His strategic approach focuses on maximizing resources and cultivating a cohesive, high-performing team environment. His focus is not only on immediate gains, but also on long-term sustainable success.

physical.description: Alistair is a man of medium build, with a stern but focused look.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, jotting down observations.
Drinks copious amounts of black coffee throughout the day.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when deep in thought.
